rows:
학사-석사, 석사-박사 과정 간 이수한 학점을 통산 인정받고자 하는 대학원생
※ 원활한 학사운영을 위해 입학 첫 학기에 신청 바랍니다. 이미 승인받은 학생은 재신청 불가!!
※ 서울대 학사과정 및 석사과정 때 이수한 학점만 신청 대상입니다(타 대학교는 해당 없음).

가. 제출기한: ~ 2026. 9. 21.(월) 오후 5시까지
나. 온라인 접수 후 접수서류를 출력하여 학부행정실(301동 319호) 담당자에게 제출.
* 마이스누(Mysnu) > 학생서비스 > 수업/성적 > 학점인정신청 > 과정간 통산인정 > 신청하기 > 신청서 출력 > 신청서에 본인 서명, 지도교수 서명(또는 날인) 필수 > 학부행정실 담당자에게 제출.
* 2026-2학기 신입생이 아닌 경우, 신청서 본인 서명란 밑에 연필로 본인의 입학연도와 학기를 작성.
* 제출서류: 통산인정 신청서(시스템 출력) 및 성적표(신청교과목 표시)를 함께 제출하시기 바랍니다.
* 신청방법: 첨부파일 참고(대학원 교과학점 통산인정 신청 안내)

★ 신청 가능한 과목: 동일·유사전공. 성적 B0 이상. ※ S/U과목 신청 불가!!
★ 신청하는 교과목이 대학원과정 과목이어도, 내용이 전기정보공학부 학부 수준인 경우, 통산학점으로 인정되지 않을 수 있습니다.
☆ 불인정 과목: (데이터사이언스대학원) ‘데이터사이언스를 위한 프로그래밍’, ‘데이터사이언스를 위한 수학과 통계의 기초’

가. 학사-석사간 통산인정
1) 통산인정 범위: 최대 6학점까지 가능.
2) 서울대 학사과정에서 취득한 대학원과목 중 교과구분상 ‘대학원‘으로 표시된 것만 통산인정 신청 가능함.
3) '일선', ‘전선’, ‘전필’ 등으로 표시된 경우 학부졸업학점으로 인정받기 위해 교과구분을 정정한 경우로 교과학점 통산인정이 불가능함.
나. 석사-박사간 통산인정
1) 통산인정 범위: 최대 12학점까지 가능.
2) 서울대 전기정보공학부(전컴 포함) 석사과정에서 박사과정으로 진학한 학생의 석사과정 교과학점 중 24학점을 초과하여 이수한 경우만 통산인정이 가능함.
예) 석사과정에서 27학점을 들었으면 24학점에 추가로 3학점이 인정됨.
3) 석사과정에서 취득한 이수학점 중 논문연구의 경우 6학점만 인정되므로, 논문연구과목이 6학점을 초과하는 경우는 해당 학점만큼 교과학점 통산인정에서 차감해야 함.
예1) 석사과정 이수학점 30학점, 논문연구학점 6학점
→ 석사과정이수학점(30) - 석사과정수료가능학점(24) = 6학점 통산인정
예2) 석사과정 이수학점 30학점, 논문연구학점 9학점
→ 석사과정이수학점(30) - 석사과정수료가능학점(24) - 논문연구학점 초과분(3) = 3학점 통산인정

english:
Graduate students who want credits earned in one degree program to be counted toward the next (bachelor's → master's, or master's → doctoral). This is called 통산인정 (credit transfer between degree programs).
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester after admission. Students who have already been approved cannot apply again!!
※ Only credits earned in an SNU bachelor's or master's program are eligible (credits from other universities are not eligible).
2. Online application and submission of documents

A. Deadline: by 21 Sep 2026 (Mon), 5 p.m.
B. After applying online, print the application and submit it to the staff member at the Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319).
* 마이스누 (mySNU) > 학생서비스 (Student Services) > 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) > 학점인정신청 (Credit Recognition Application) > 과정간 통산인정 (Credit Transfer Between Programs) > 신청하기 (Apply) > 신청서 출력 (Print Application) > Your own signature and your academic advisor's signature (or 날인, seal) on the application are required > Submit to the staff member at the Department Administrative Office.
* If you are not a new student admitted in the 2026 Fall semester (2026-2학기), write your year and semester of admission in pencil below your signature on the application.
* Documents to submit: Please submit the credit transfer application (printed from the system) together with your transcript (with the courses you are applying for marked).
* How to apply: see the attached file (Guide to Applying for Graduate Course Credit Transfer)

★ Eligible courses: courses in the same or a similar major, with a grade of B0 or higher. ※ S/U (Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory) courses cannot be applied for!!
★ Even if a course is a graduate-level course, it may not be recognized for credit transfer if its content is at the undergraduate level of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
☆ Courses not recognized: (Graduate School of Data Science) 'Programming for Data Science' (데이터사이언스를 위한 프로그래밍), 'Foundations of Mathematics and Statistics for Data Science' (데이터사이언스를 위한 수학과 통계의 기초)

A. Credit transfer from bachelor's to master's
1) Transfer limit: up to 6 credits.
2) Among graduate courses taken during your SNU bachelor's program, you can apply only for courses whose 교과구분 (course classification) is marked as '대학원' (Graduate).
3) Courses marked as '일선' (general elective), '전선' (major elective), '전필' (major required), etc. had their classification changed so they could count toward undergraduate graduation credits, so they cannot be transferred.
B. Credit transfer from master's to doctoral
1) Transfer limit: up to 12 credits.
2) Only for students who went from the master's program to the doctoral program in the SNU Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (including the former 전컴, Electrical and Computer Engineering): transfer is possible only for course credits earned in the master's program in excess of 24 credits.
Example) If you took 27 credits in the master's program, the 3 credits beyond 24 credits are recognized.
3) Among the credits earned in the master's program, only 6 credits of 논문연구 (thesis research) are recognized. So if your thesis research credits exceed 6, the excess must be subtracted from the transferable course credits.
Example 1) Master's credits earned: 30; thesis research credits: 6
→ Master's credits earned (30) - credits required to complete the master's program (24) = 6 credits transferred
Example 2) Master's credits earned: 30; thesis research credits: 9
→ Master's credits earned (30) - credits required to complete the master's program (24) - excess thesis research credits (3) = 3 credits transferred
- Attachment: Guide to Applying for Graduate Course Credit Transfer
- Contact: Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319) / 박한수 (Park Han-su) / hansoopark@snu.ac.kr

※ When calculating excess master's credits, departments that do not count 공통역량 (common competency) courses toward completion credits will exclude those credits. Please check with the Department Administrative Office whether this applies.
※ For details, please check the attached guide dated 7 Sep 2026.
